summary: Rename all eleven ChatGPT MCP tools from st_* to fractal_*

replay.detail: No stored state or replay changes.

schema.detail: No stored schema, index, or data changes.

rules.detail: No daemon admission or checkpoint rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Johannes's ChatGPT connector caches its tool list and depends on st_* names. All eleven old names remain deprecated callable aliases for the fractal-chatgpt 0.1.0 release only; remove them in the next adapter release, fractal-chatgpt 0.2.0. Aliases normalize to the same canonical name before validation and dispatch. They are hidden from tools/list so refreshed connectors see only fractal_* while cached calls continue to work. Description cross-references use canonical fractal_* names; all other wording, input constraints, annotations and daemon payloads are unchanged. No dotfiles main plugin or context references to these eleven names were found.

downtime.detail: No daemon restart or deployment changes are required by this patch.

manual.detail: Refresh the ChatGPT connector tool list and migrate other callers to fractal_* before fractal-chatgpt 0.2.0. The repository's MCP integration and prototype E2E clients now use canonical names.

recovery.detail: No state migration or repair is needed. Cached st_* calls remain supported for this release.
